scope: Original independent judge actual-used native/currentconsumer controls and final visual/technical evidence. Every file<100MB. Unsubmitted preflight directories are not reviewed candidates.
acyclicExclusions: Final review binds this manifest. Gate binds review. Postseal binds review+manifest+gate; these are deliberately excluded from the supplemental manifest.
finalize-review.log/run-final-gate.log are execution receipts generated after manifest; postseal records final gate JSON.
resourceClosure: Native source copies, exact current helpers, own saved drivers/options/versions/commands/logs/raw captures, own isolated Vite compiled dependencies and package metadata. Installed Blender/Node/Python binaries version/hash-bound, not copied.
